t: Refactoring AI Perception: From `browser_automation` to `browser_cache` with LPvg Principles
s: This article details refactoring browser automation to browser cache using LPvg (Linux, Python, vim, git) principles. It emphasizes building durable AI tooling for co-evolution with AI's 18-month advancement cadence, ensuring computing sovereignty against proprietary vendor lock-in.
sub: Durable AI Tooling vs. Vendor Lock-in
